title: Global economy in crosscurrents of conflict and technology
summary: The IMF expects global growth to soften in 2026 before improving in 2027. Inflation progress has stalled, while energy shocks, geopolitical fragmentation and uneven AI-related investment remain important risks.
risks: Energy and geopolitical shocks can slow growth and revive inflation.
The outlook differs sharply between energy importers, exporters and technology supply-chain beneficiaries.
High public debt leaves less policy room if growth weakens.
source_note: Official forecast reference; market proxy data in the dashboard updates separately.
